messages.content: Using only search results from the enabled Protocol Search tool (do not use its fetch operation, general web search, or direct web fetching), design an end-to-end protocol for long-duration three-dimensional tracking of a fluorescently labeled, mobile subcellular structure in living cells. I need high axial precision and short imaging intervals, but repeated z-stacks cause too much delay and phototoxicity. Include microscope setup or modifications, calibration, the live acquisition and control workflow, validation, downstream analysis, checkpoints, and practical timing. Use only the available pre-July evidence and label unsupported details as assumptions.
